title: Computer Vision Arcade
intro: How well does AI see? Prove it! Nail every round on the first try for ⭐⭐⭐.

rounds.prompt: What does Computer Vision help machines do?
rounds.explain: Computer Vision helps computers 'see' and understand visual information.

rounds.prompt: To a computer, an image is really a...
rounds.explain: Images are stored as numbers describing each pixel's color.

rounds.prompt: Match each vision task to what it does.
rounds.explain: Classification labels the whole image, detection boxes objects, and facial recognition matches a face to a person.
Face unlock uses computer vision to recognize your face.

solution: Collect example images for each class
Test it with a live image
